content: Restrictions on direct and trusted function call con- figurations in the scope of RTE Implementation Plug-Ins Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00305 If an RTE Generator supports an activation of ExecutableEntity s via direct or trusted function call listed in [SWS_Rte_80029] only when the support for RTE Im- plementation Plug-Ins is enabled the input configuration needs to fulfill following condition: • all Communication Graphs , ExclusiveArea s and mode machine in- stances accessed by the to-be-activated ExecutableEntity are assigned to RTE Implementation Plug-Ins s AND • the to-be-activated ExecutableEntity do not in turn activate RTEEvent s or BswEvent s which are mapped to OsTask s.
